The main takeaway from our work is that
firm-level bargaining can be an effective policy tool for reducing unemployment in the face of firm heterogeneity.
the labor market impact of sector-level bargaining depends crucially on the possibility of efficient opting-out.
the labor market impact of collective bargaining depends crucially on the level at which bargaining takes place, as well as on the extent to which firms are allowed to escape sector-level agreements.
